verdict.rationale: The official Fivetran MCP server can copy existing connections to a new destination with configs and schemas intact, and write and delete scopes are available. The REST API lets users scale and manage the account programmatically, so multi-item operations are possible through scripting or an agent. However, no dedicated bulk-operation feature is documented. Missing for 10: documented batch or bulk API endpoints, bulk edit/pause/re-sync across many connections in the UI or API, and hands-on corroboration of bulk agent workflows.
